title: 甲状腺手術後 定期フォロー
description: 耳鼻咽喉科・頭頸部外科の定期再診で、甲状腺機能・超音波所見・チラーヂン補充量を評価するシナリオ。

tasks.title: 直近の甲状腺機能の確認
tasks.description: TSH, fT4, fT3 の推移を確認する。

data_nodes.description: TSH, fT4, fT3 の直近12か月推移
data_nodes.sql: SELECT "報告日" AS "検査日", MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='TSH' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS "TSH", MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT4' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS "fT4", MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT3' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS "fT3" FROM "検体検査結果" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "報告日">=date('now','-12 months') AND "検査項目" IN ('TSH','fT4','fT3') GROUP BY "報告日" ORDER BY "報告日"

tasks.title: 直近の超音波画像の確認
tasks.description: 残存甲状腺の形態変化を前回と比較する。

data_nodes.description: 甲状腺超音波の直近2回比較
data_nodes.sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT "報告日", COALESCE("所見", '-') AS "所見", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "報告日" DESC) AS rn FROM "生理検査レポート" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "レポート名" LIKE '%甲状腺超音波%' ) SELECT '### 超音波所見（直近比較）' || char(10) || '- 最新(' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM recent WHERE rn=1), '-') || '): ' || COALESCE((SELECT "所見" FROM recent WHERE rn=1), '-') || char(10) || '- 前回(' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM recent WHERE rn=2), '-') || '): ' || COALESCE((SELECT "所見" FROM recent WHERE rn=2), '-') AS "echo_compare_markdown"

tasks.title: 精密検査検討のための所見確認
tasks.description: 最新の甲状腺超音波所見を確認する。

data_nodes.description: 精密検査検討のための最新超音波所見
data_nodes.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT "報告日", COALESCE("所見", '-') AS "所見" FROM "生理検査レポート" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "レポート名" LIKE '%甲状腺超音波%' ORDER BY "報告日" DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT '### 最新の超音波所見' || char(10) || '- 報告日: ' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM latest), '-') || char(10) || '- 所見: ' || COALESCE((SELECT "所見" FROM latest), '-') AS "latest_echo_finding_markdown"

tasks.title: チラーヂン補充量の確認
tasks.description: 外来処方におけるチラーヂン補充量の推移を確認する。

widgets.title: チラーヂン投与量推移

data_nodes.description: チラーヂン補充量の直近12か月推移
data_nodes.sql: SELECT "服薬開始日" AS "処方日", CAST("一日量" AS REAL) AS "チラーヂン量(μg/日)" FROM "処方" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "薬剤名" LIKE '%チラーヂン%' AND "服薬開始日">=date('now','-12 months') ORDER BY "服薬開始日"

tasks.title: チラーヂン補充量変更のための情報確認
tasks.description: 直近の甲状腺機能と最新のチラーヂン補充量を確認する。

widgets.title: 最新甲状腺機能と補充量

data_nodes.description: 直近の甲状腺機能と最新チラーヂン補充量
data_nodes.sql: WITH latest_labs AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='TSH' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS tsh, MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT4' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS ft4, MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT3' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS ft3, "報告日" FROM "検体検査結果" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "検査項目" IN ('TSH','fT4','fT3') GROUP BY "報告日" ORDER BY "報告日" DESC LIMIT 1), latest_dose AS (SELECT CAST("一日量" AS REAL) AS dose, "一日量単位", "服薬開始日" FROM "処方" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "薬剤名" LIKE '%チラーヂン%' ORDER BY "服薬開始日" DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT '### 最新の甲状腺機能とチラーヂン補充量' || char(10) || '- 検査日: ' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM latest_labs), '-') || char(10) || '- TSH: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT tsh FROM latest_labs) AS TEXT), '-') || ', fT4: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ft4 FROM latest_labs) AS TEXT), '-') || ', fT3: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ft3 FROM latest_labs) AS TEXT), '-') || char(10) || '- 最新処方日: ' || COALESCE((SELECT "服薬開始日" FROM latest_dose), '-') || char(10) || '- チラーヂン補充量: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT dose FROM latest_dose) AS TEXT), '-') || ' ' || COALESCE((SELECT "一日量単位" FROM latest_dose), 'μg/日') AS "latest_levothyroxine_status_markdown"
